_about: Termbase entries removed from en-bo-en-termbase-general.json, kept here instead of deleted. Each entry is stored exactly as it was, with the grade-file keywords that used it.

venerable_tara.reason: Gapped form རྗེ་བཙུན་མ...སྒྲོལ་མ (validate_grade_file W1) can never match a text or be sent as a glossary line. Redundant: I-3 is already covered by 'noble_venerable' (རྗེ་བཙུན་མ་འཕགས་མ → Noble and Venerable) + 'tara' (སྒྲོལ་མ → Tara). Its locked rendering 'the venerable Tārā' was also never used in the fact-checked text, which reads 'the Noble and Venerable Tara'.
